title: Refuse resumed effects when the authorization epoch advanced
narrative: Checkpoints carry the authorization epoch so crash recovery after revocation does not continue with stale authority. A resume under an envelope whose epoch differs from the checkpoint fails closed before any runner is invoked; pre-epoch checkpoints read as epoch 0. Effect ledger and idempotent resume ship in `fangore_transactional_durable_resume`. Tracks MH-DOTS-06[^insp-dots-06].
implementation: `ExecutionGraph.authorization_epoch` is stamped from the live `CapabilityEnvelope` at run time and persisted by every `CheckpointStore` (EventLog and SQLite) inside the graph checkpoint; `CheckpointStore.latest_authorization_epoch` reads it (0 when absent). `GraphExecutor.run(resume=True, envelope=...)` returns `failed` with `authorization_epoch_mismatch:<checkpoint>!=<live>` when they differ. Pending reviews and idempotency keys remain via `approval_interrupt` and the effect ledger.
validation: Harness `access_authority` op `auth_epoch_resume_refuse`. Hard expects first run ok with epoch persisted, resume under an advanced epoch failed with `authorization_epoch_mismatch`, and no runner re-entered.
